meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先写测试再写功能，让每次改动都有测试兜底
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想每步改动都先有测试兜底、不怕改坏旧逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Write the test first, then the code, so every change stays covered
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want each change backed by a test written first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按「红→绿」循环工作:先写一个失败的测试,再写刚好让它通过的最小实现,一次一个切片。动手前会先和你确认要测哪些公开边界(seam),测试只验证公开接口的行为,不绑内部实现细节。
howto.when: 当你想要以测试先行方式开发功能或修 bug、提到 “red-green-refactor”,或想要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 我想用测试先行开发这个功能,先一起确定要测哪些 seam
say.note: Claude 会先和你确认 seam,再写失败测试

say.text: 用红绿循环修这个 bug
say.note: 先写一个能复现 bug 的失败测试

say.text: 帮我看看这个测试是不是绑定了实现细节
say.note: 对照反模式清单给出判断

howto.what_en: Claude works in the red→green loop: write one failing test, then the minimal code to pass it, one slice at a time. Before writing tests it agrees the public seams with you, and tests behavior through public interfaces, not internals.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.text: Build this feature test-first — let's agree on the seams first
say_en.note: Claude confirms seams before writing any test

say_en.text: Fix this bug with the red-green loop
say_en.note: Starts with a failing test that reproduces the bug

say_en.text: Check whether this test is coupled to implementation details
say_en.note: Checks it against the anti-pattern list
